topic: One Piece chapter 1198 reaction: Luffy's new monkey-like form (fans call it Gear 6) read as the Zoan side of the Nika fruit awakening against Imu's third form, and what it sets up for Dragon
title: Luffy LOST CONTROL?! Gear 6 Changes The War (One Piece 1198)
description:
One Piece 1198 explained: Luffy turns into a monkey-like form that fans are calling Gear 6, Imu shows a third form the size of an Ancient Giant, and Loki's hybrid form still isn't enough. I argue the new form is the Zoan side of the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika answering Imu, and I walk through the chapters that built it.

Every claim is tied to a chapter number, the Dragon part is clearly marked as theory, and Oda hasn't named the form. Is it growth or a loss of control, and what should chapter 1199 answer?
comment: Is Luffy's new 1198 form growth he controls, or Nika taking the wheel? Pick one and tell me why.

lines.text: One Piece 1198 turns Luffy into a dark, monkey-like beast that laughs like an animal, and fans call it Gear 6.

shot.fallback: anime style swirling storm clouds over a giant village, shadowy giant figure

lines.text: Oda hasn't named it, so Gear 6 is just a nickname, and I think it hides the real story.

shot.fallback: anime style swirling storm clouds over a giant village, shadowy giant figure

lines.text: So did Luffy lose himself in the middle of the final war, or is this the fruit's other half answering Imu?

shot.fallback: anime style swirling storm clouds over a giant village, shadowy giant figure

lines.text: My read is that it's a bit of both, and I'll show you the chapters that prove it...

lines.text: Because Luffy just left Loki alone with Imu, and where he went is what changes the war...

shot.fallback: anime style swirling storm clouds over a giant village, shadowy giant figure

lines.text: Start with the central forest, where Loki finally takes his hybrid form to fight Imu.

lines.text: Imu answers by transforming again, into an even more monstrous form, a colossal evil god about the size of an Ancient Giant.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: That's his third form, after the winged first one and the tougher second one that shrugged off Hajrudin, Loki and Gear 5 together.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Loki froze him solid back in chapter 1178, and Imu simply walked it off.

shot.search: Loki Imu Niflheim ice Adam Tree
shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: So this was never a fight Loki could win by trying harder.

shot.search: Loki Imu Niflheim ice Adam Tree
shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: It goes badly. Imu demands the ancient technology he thinks is hidden on Elbaph.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Loki says he knows nothing, and Imu cuts him down.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: And inside his own head, Imu admits he has hit his limit.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: If he doesn't get back to Mary Geoise soon, his life is in real danger.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Now here's the odd part. Luffy isn't there for any of it.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Usopp is the one who says why: he turned into something, and ran off.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Loki calls him a coward for leaving him alone, and says that if he flees or dies, Elbaph is enslaved either way.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: So Luffy walks away from the biggest fight on the island, and goes to the Western Village.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Where Sanji is holding the line, and I love this detail: his Supreme King Haki shatters Killingham's entire Omen Panzer.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Sanji tells Killingham not to hope for Sommers, because Zoro already went by.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Meanwhile Zaza, the water monster Killingham controls, stretches over the giants and drops four giant children onto the escape ship.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Then Sanji senses someone behind him. It looks like Luffy.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: But his body goes dark, he moves like a monkey, and he sounds like one too.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: He grabs Zaza by the middle, bites into it, and inflates it with air until it explodes, laughing like a monkey the whole time.

shot.search: Luffy monkey form fangs tail rain god
shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Everyone watching is shocked, and that includes Sanji, a man who has already seen Gear 5.

shot.search: Luffy monkey form fangs tail rain god
shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Far away on Branch Route 8, Jinbe senses two huge surges of Haki heading for the village.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: He thinks one of them is Luffy, though it doesn't feel like him.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: One reviewer says the form looks possessed by Nika's will, but the chapter never says that, so it's a reading and not a fact.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Then Gaban, carried off by Usopp, asks the question I was already asking.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Is Luffy actually a Zoan type, and could that decide this battle?

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: That line matters, because Gaban is a former Roger Pirate who fought Imu himself, and he thinks Zoan before anyone else does.

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: So here's the question I kept asking while I read it: why would a fruit built on transformation stop at one face?

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: And why would the second face show up now, against a water monster, instead of against Imu?

shot.fallback: anime style giant village battlefield, towering demon god and a giant in armor

lines.text: Start with the name the World Government never wanted you to hear, the Hito Hito no Mi, Model Nika.

shot.search: Hito Hito no Mi Model Nika
shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: That is a Mythical Zoan, and the Government renamed it the Gomu Gomu no Mi to bury the truth, as chapter 1044 spells out.

shot.search: Gomu Gomu no Mi Mythical Zoan
shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: For most of the series, even Luffy thought of it as a Paramecia that simply makes him rubber.

shot.search: Luffy Gomu Gomu no Mi Paramecia
shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: Chapter 1044 breaks that, when Luffy awakens the fruit after losing to Kaido a third time, with Guernika's interference deciding it.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: In chapter 1045 Kaido compares the awakening to a Zoan transformation, and by 1046 Luffy is turning lightning around him into rubber.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: The Five Elders said in chapter 1037 that nobody had awakened the fruit for centuries, and they feared it enough to risk Kaido's wrath.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: Here is the Zoan rule that matters. A normal Zoan has a full beast form and a man-beast hybrid form.

shot.search: Zoan Devil Fruit full beast hybrid
shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: I think Gear 5 is the human-shaped end of that ladder, with a laugh, a cartoon body, and a trail of clouds.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: My theory is that the monkey is the other end of that ladder, the beast stage of a Mythical Zoan that Gear 5 never showed.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: I'm calling it a theory on purpose, because Oda hasn't said it, but the wiki leans my way.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: It says that in the Elbaph Arc Luffy took an animalistic transformation, and was publicly viewed as a Zoan user afterward.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: And the fruit's history says this wouldn't be new. Joy Boy awakened it around 900 years ago, per chapter 1115.

shot.search: Joy Boy Void Century Hito Hito no Mi
shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: Egghead hinted at it too. Vegapunk found no old book that mentioned the Gomu Gomu no Mi.

shot.search: Vegapunk Luffy Gear 5 Sun God Nika
shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: So he compared Gear 5 to the Sun God legends instead.

shot.search: Vegapunk Luffy Gear 5 Sun God Nika
shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: The wiki also says the awakened fruit can turn the world around Luffy into rubber, even living things, which no normal Zoan can do.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: I think that's why the Elders panicked, and why Imu is the one who actually fears it.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: He screamed in agony at Joy Boy's Haki at Egghead, chapter 1122.

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: But why would the fruit show a new face now, in this fight, against this opponent?

shot.fallback: anime style glowing sun god fruit on an ancient altar, white clouds

lines.text: Look at how Imu has been treating Luffy.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: In chapter 1177 he calls Luffy Nika and Loki Nidhöggr, and gives them one choice: submit, or die.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Think about what that tells you. He already knows exactly which fruits he's facing, and he warns that the fight could split the world.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Then he stabs both of them with Domi Reversi to turn them on each other, and both simply shrug it off.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Imu's own power turns people into demons, as Dorry and Brogy found out in chapter 1172.

shot.search: Imu Dorry Brogy demons Domi Reversi
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: And two Zoan users, Luffy and Loki, refuse to be turned.

shot.search: Imu Dorry Brogy demons Domi Reversi
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: I think that's no accident, because a fruit built on transformation is going to reject someone else's version of it.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: In chapter 1187 Luffy shows his giant Gear 5, and Imu says Joy Boy has come back, until Luffy rejects the name.

shot.search: Luffy giant Gear 5 Imu Joy Boy
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Then chapter 1188 is the low point. Imu pins him to a tree with Bohu, a sword that drains him.

shot.search: Imu Bohu sword Luffy Adam Tree
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: And he says Joy Boy wouldn't have been so weak.

shot.search: Imu Bohu sword Luffy Adam Tree
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: In chapter 1189 Gaban jumps in, blocks Imu's slash, and tells Luffy that the Pirate King's seat is not for the weak.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: So Luffy gets back up, and in chapter 1191 he, Loki and Hajrudin hit Imu with San Sho: Gokoku.

shot.search: Luffy Loki Hajrudin San Sho Gokoku
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: In chapters 1192 and 1193, Loki's lightning and the Dawn Thor Bullet hammer Imu so hard the Adam Tree shakes.

shot.search: Luffy Dawn Thor Bullet Imu shield
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Then Luffy's body gives out, and he collapses.

shot.search: Luffy Dawn Thor Bullet Imu shield
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Notice the pattern. Every time Gear 5 lands something big, Imu stands back up, and he gets bigger when he does.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Wings and a tail, then a tougher body, then a god-sized third form.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Imu climbs in stages, and Gear 5 hasn't climbed with him.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: That's my why-now: Imu's ladder just outgrew Gear 5, so I think the fruit climbs too.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: And here's a mirror I think Oda did on purpose: the wiki says Imu's devil power resembles a Mythical Zoan as well.

shot.search: Imu Akuma no Mi Mythical Zoan
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Two stage-by-stage powers colliding, one built on domination and the other on liberation.

shot.search: Imu Luffy Nika Joy Boy Elbaph
shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: Imu also has a clock. He can't leave Mary Geoise without his ailment acting up, per chapter 1162.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: And in 1198 he admits his life is in danger if he doesn't go back.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: A man with a clock is dangerous in a different way, because he has nothing left to hold back.

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: But there's a catch with all of this, and it's the part that worries me...

shot.fallback: anime style ominous demon god looming over ancient treasure tree

lines.text: The strongest counter-argument is that this is not growth at all but a loss of control, and the wiki's own chapter notes lean that way.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: They say Luffy has seemingly lost himself to the fruit's animal instincts, and he does leave Loki alone with Imu.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: Gear 5 already has a price. In chapter 1045 Luffy looks drained after using it for a long stretch against Kaido.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: And at Egghead, Saturn sees Luffy severely weakened after the Kizaru fight, and tries to kill him, until Franky steps in.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: So I understand anyone who thinks the monkey form is just a more dangerous bill coming due.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: But I'd call it instinct, not chaos, and the chapter gives me three reasons.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: One, he doesn't rampage at random.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: He goes straight to the monster that just dropped four children onto an escape ship, and takes it apart.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: Two, he left Loki, but Loki himself says that fleeing or dying means Elbaph is lost.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: So Luffy went after the other half of that loss.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: Three, Gaban doesn't treat it like a breakdown. He treats it like a possible Zoan trump card.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: Gaban is the man who saved Luffy in chapter 1189, so I trust his read.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: Even so, I'll admit the open question. Who is steering, Luffy or Nika, and could it be both at once?

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: There's also a tonal tell. The wiki says Gear 5 spreads joy and laughter, even to enemies.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: This form laughs too, but like a monkey, and everyone around it is stunned instead of laughing back.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: That could mean it's rage, or fear, or something older than either, and honestly I can't tell which yet.

shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: Because if Joy Boy awakened this fruit 900 years ago, a form this primal might be the oldest thing in it...

shot.search: Joy Boy Nika ancient Void Century
shot.fallback: anime style lone figure with glowing eyes in a dark forest, giant shadows

lines.text: So here's what I think this form changes about the war, even if Luffy never fully controls it.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: One, Imu has been measuring Luffy against the boy he pinned to a tree in chapter 1188.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: That is not the Luffy who just popped a water monster like a balloon.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Two, Imu is on a clock, so a fighter he can't predict is the last thing he needs.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Three, Elbaph's defense now leans on a captain nobody can talk to, and Loki just found out what that costs.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Now the part that's pure theory, and I want to be upfront about it: nothing in 1198 puts Dragon on the page.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: But the setup is already sitting in the story.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: In chapter 1082, Dragon tells Sabo and Ivankov the Government will eventually send the Knights of God.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: He says it will mean a serious battle.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Those Knights are now fighting on Elbaph, and Imu himself has come with them.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Chapter 1102 shows Dragon going to Loguetown just to watch his son sail, and saying that Luffy being Pirate King is fine with him.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: After Vegapunk's broadcast, Dragon told his people they had to win before others started fighting over land, in chapter 1125.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: In chapter 1178 Imu told the Elders to rule in his stead and left for Elbaph with Mary Geoise still in flames.

shot.search: Mary Geoise Holy Land fire Imu
shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: So the ruler of the Government is stuck far from home, fighting Luffy's fruit, while his seat of power is exposed.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Dragon is Luffy's father, a former Marine who left after God Valley, per chapter 1166.

shot.search: Monkey D. Dragon God Valley Marines
shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: He has led a resistance for at least 25 years.

shot.search: Monkey D. Dragon God Valley Marines
shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Whatever else Dragon plans, a window like this is exactly what a revolution waits for.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: I could be wrong about timing, since nothing in 1198 says Dragon is anywhere near Elbaph.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: But even if he arrives late, a second front means Imu can't afford to spend his whole stay chasing one pirate.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Chapter 1199 comes after a one-week break, so everything I just said about Dragon stays a theory until then.

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: What I want chapter 1199 to answer is simple: who is steering, how long can the form last, and can Loki hold?

shot.fallback: anime style burning holy castle at dusk, revolutionary ships on the horizon

lines.text: Imu taught Luffy's fruit that Gear 5 wasn't enough, and I think Oda is about to show us what it says back.

shot.search: Luffy monkey silhouette Imu god form
